messages:
Alex Chen: quick heads-up — I'm stepping out at 23:45 UTC. I'm primary until 00:30 per schedule but need to hand the last 2 hours to Priya. @Priya can you take primary from 00:00-02:00 UTC?

OpsBot: Reminder: current primary = Alex Chen (until 00:30 UTC). Secondary = Ben Ortiz. Paging policy: page primary then secondary.

Priya Nair: I can take 00:00-02:00.

Alex Chen: thanks. PagerDuty transfer is manual. Typical flow: run `pagerduty-cli oncall transfer --to "Priya Nair"` and then update the oncall schedule in /infra/oncall. I'll run the PD transfer and paste the success output here. Also note there is a cron maintenance window 00:00-00:10 that can cause transient latency spikes — please monitor dashboards.

Ben Ortiz: fyi I have a deploy at 00:15 that may increase load on model-serving. If latency pages, route to me for mitigation (I'll handle quick rollbacks).

Alex Chen: doing PD transfer now...
```
Success: oncall role 'primary' transferred to Priya Nair
Routing rules updated.
```
Screenshot: https://files.redwood.internal/screenshots/pd-transfer-1738201234.png

Jamie L: quick question — any active customer-facing incidents we should flag during the swap? Trying to update the customer-impact board.

Priya Nair: no active customer incidents. There was a transient eu-west throttling alert earlier but it auto-resolved. I'll add eu-west model-serving dashboards to my watchlist. Runbook: https://runbooks.redwood.internal/model-serving/latency-response (see steps 1-4).

OpsBot: Reminder: annotate handoff in #oncall-logs with `/handoff annotate` and include reason and expected gap.

Alex Chen: annotated with reason "early leave, transfer to Priya" and expected gap 00:00-00:10.

Ben Ortiz: added myself to Priya's watchlist. If 5xx rate > 0.5% for 5m, I will escalate. Also, if CPU on gpu-pool-02 > 85% for 3m, notify secondary immediately.

Priya Nair: acknowledged. I'll enable temporary alert suppression for the maintenance cron to avoid noisy pages and keep stricter thresholds for real errors.

Alex Chen: leaving now — Priya is primary at 00:00 UTC, Ben remains secondary. Thanks all. :thumbsup:

Priya Nair: taking over. I'll post status at 00:10 and when stable. Ping me directly for any urgent pages.

OpsBot: Handoff recorded: from Alex Chen to Priya Nair at 00:00 UTC. Handoff log: https://logs.redwood.internal/handoffs/1738201234

Jamie L: noted for customer-impact board. Thanks everyone.
